abstract: Testicular biopsies were done in 15 consecutive patients who were believed to have extragonadal germ-cell tumours. 8 patients (53%) had carcinoma-in-situ (CIS) in the gonads, although none had clinical signs of tumour. In addition, 3 of these patients had small areas of invasive tumour growth. Germ-cell tumours can only be diagnosed as being extragonadal in origin if testicular biopsy appearances are normal.
abstract_ja: 連続する15例の患者で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と考えられたため精巣生検を行った。そのうち8例(53%)が性腺に上皮内癌(CIS)を有していたが、いずれも臨床的に腫瘍の徴候はなかった。さらに、これらの患者のうち3例には浸潤性腫瘍の増殖が小さな領域に認められた。胚細胞腫瘍が性腺外起源と診断できるのは、精巣生検所見が正常な場合に限られる。
